versions.changelog:
monid 0.1.7

- Expanded and clarified usage documentation, including when to use Monid versus other tools.
- Added detailed setup and authentication instructions, covering CLI installation, setup, and API key management.
- Documented endpoint health statuses and how to interpret health in search and run decisions.
- Explained command-line arguments and output structure for all major commands.
- Updated guidance on user workflow integration and when to favor user-supplied tools over Monid endpoints.
